Shop.title: Shop
Shop.description: A shop profile and owner access record for multi-shop isolation.

ShopRecord.title: ShopRecord
ShopRecord.description: A shop-scoped entity record (product, bill, order, dayClosing, supplierLedger, or staff entry).

StaffDirectoryEntry.title: StaffDirectoryEntry
StaffDirectoryEntry.description: Unique 10-digit mobile lookup entry linking a staff member to their shop and hashed PIN.

/shops/{shopId}.description: Root shop metadata and ownerCode verification document.

/shops/{shopId}/products/{productId}.description: Inventory products belonging to this shop.

/shops/{shopId}/bills/{billId}.description: Bills and customer khata records belonging to this shop.

/shops/{shopId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer orders belonging to this shop.

/shops/{shopId}/dayClosings/{closingId}.description: Daily closing records belonging to this shop.

/shops/{shopId}/supplierLedger/{supplier.description: Supplier ledger accounts and transactions belonging to this shop.

/shops/{shopId}/staff/{staffId}.description: Staff accounts (Manager & Cashier) belonging to this shop.

/staffDirectory/{mobile}.description: Global unique mobile lookup linking staff mobile to shopId without exposing Owner Code.
